timeline.summary: Paras Defence signed an MoU with Complus Systems and JV Micronics for anechoic chambers.

Promoter **Sharad Virji Shah** and **Promoter Group** (including Munjal Sharad Shah, Kaajal Harsh Bhansali, etc.) declared no new encumbrances on shares of **Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited** as of **March 31, 2026**, per SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Paras Defence received a ₹7.72 crore order from DRDO for development of airborne satellite communication phased array antennas by April 2028.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹171.31 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹34.38 Cr.
PARAS’ management, led by **Minal Bhate**, will host an Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet at Taj Hotel, Mumbai on May 27, 2026, with 24 listed participants.
Paras Defence received an order of ₹52.82 Cr from Bharat Electronics Limited for supplying electro-optics by September 2027.

Paras Defence and Space Technologies Limited’s management will meet analysts/institutional investors on June 09, 2026, at 10:00 AM IST at its Nerul office, organized by Citigroup Global Markets India.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹151.12 Cr (+42.9% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹30.3 Cr (+46.8% YoY).
